scope: Exact original application instructions with explicit intercepted libc and CCL string provider semantics; no original Core/libc instruction execution. Real pinned CCL used in compiled C++ replay. Outputs and guard bytes checked; uninitialized unused string-tail bytes excluded. All integer boundaries including ARM32 addition wrap, null/empty/long default string. Private emulator memory only, no syscalls/network/devices. Isolated candidate sources; not integration/readiness/ARM ABI proof.
